name: HH breakout 05 — fakeout fade reversion, short the up-wick (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: the mirror of the down-wick fade — 60-80% of raw crypto breakouts fail, and an UPSIDE break to a well-watched range high in a range regime is a liquidity-grab that sweeps resting sell-stops / triggers breakout-buyers before reverting. Enter SHORT (direction -1) when range_position is at the HIGH extreme (>0.98, fitted) while bb_width is NOT compressed (range regime, fitted ceiling keeps us out of true squeeze breaks) and adx is LOW (chop). Kept SEPARATE from the down-wick long because the up-wick short must earn against crypto's upward drift, making it a genuinely different, honestly-judged cell. Counterparty: the retail breakout-chaser buying the high who is then trapped. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the fade's realized reversion from the extreme-touch bar does not beat the fee+slippage round-trip on a majority of symbols per-symbol — or if the up-side fade specifically loses to the upward drift (the down-wick long survives but this does not), or if the reversion has moved intra-bar in the 2025 holdout so the close entry misses it. Net-of-fees profit factor <1.2 on holdout = dead.
catalyst: up-wick sweep of a range high in a choppy regime
